title: How AI Understands You
hook: Ever wondered how ChatGPT always knows what word comes next?

scenes.narration: Ever wonder how ChatGPT always seems to know exactly what word comes next when you are chatting with it?
Large language models work in three simple steps. They break your sentence into small pieces called tokens, then predict the next token again and again.
bullets: Repeat until the reply is done

scenes.narration: Think of a token like a puzzle piece. A token is just a chunk of text, sometimes a whole word and sometimes only a few letters.
scenes.definition: A chunk of text a language model reads or writes
